explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1190 and the reported resolution ε_m = L(m)^{-1+o(1)} with L(m) = exp(√(log m log log m)), encoded as two-sided bounds L^{-1∓ε} for large m. eps m is the supremum of Σ1/n over finite sets of distinct moduli > m admitting pairwise disjoint residue classes. It is bounded (by < 1), so the real sSup is meaningful. A formal proof is linked.
